//: 9.7: every runtime dependency of a published package, and why it is there. scripts/check-supply-chain.mjs fails when a package.json has one that is not listed here (or lists one that is gone). Adding a runtime dependency means adding its reason in the same PR.

@nexub/icons.lucide-react: the icon set; every icon is re-exported with Nexub sizing

@nexub/mcp.@modelcontextprotocol/sdk: the MCP protocol implementation (pinned exactly: it runs with the user's permissions)

@nexub/react.@nexub/core: shared types, messages and money helpers
@nexub/react.@radix-ui/react-*: accessible behaviour (focus, dismissal, roving tabindex, typeahead) for the component of the same name
@nexub/react.@tanstack/react-table: DataTable's row model: sorting, filtering, grouping, pinning
@nexub/react.tailwind-merge: lets a consumer's className override ours (inside cn)
@nexub/react.cmdk: CommandPalette and Combobox filtering and keyboard model
@nexub/react.date-fns: locale-aware date parsing and formatting for the date components
@nexub/react.react-day-picker: the calendar grid and its keyboard model
@nexub/react.get-nonce: shares the CSP nonce with Radix's scroll lock

@nexub/react-native.@nexub/core: shared types, messages and money helpers
@nexub/react-native.@nexub/tokens: the design tokens the theme is built from
@nexub/react-native.lucide-react-native: the icon set for React Native

@nexub/themes.@nexub/tokens: the CSS variables the themes are written against

@nexub/tokens.@material/material-color-utilities: HCT tonal palettes for seeded brand themes (pinned exactly: its output is the contrast guarantee)
